# Connectify

> Connectify is a social collaboration platform that helps you discover nearby people for real-world activities — study sessions, trips, sports, events, carpooling, and more.

Connectify connects people based on shared activities and proximity, not just social graphs. Users create and join collaborations, communicate in temporary group chats, and rate each other after meetings.

## Homepage

- Homepage: https://connectify.aakarsh.xyz

## Public Pages

- About: https://connectify.aakarsh.xyz/about
- Privacy Policy: https://connectify.aakarsh.xyz/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://connectify.aakarsh.xyz/terms

## Key Features

- Location-based collaboration discovery
- Activity categories: Study, Sports, Travel, Carpool, Events, and more
- Temporary group chats for collaboration members
- Trust and safety through community ratings
- Google OAuth sign-in
- Progressive Web App (PWA) support
